_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five operating groups with $23.90B bookings in FY09; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live: Accenture's own FY2009 10-K names off-shore providers, 'particularly Indian providers ... often at highly competitive prices', among its competitors and says it is 'experiencing pricing pressures from some clients' and has 'shifted to lower-cost resources at reduced price levels', while its own Global Delivery Network stood at 81,000+ people. The stock trades at 16.9x FY10E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (OFFSHORE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing offshore substitution for ACN specifically.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five operating groups with $23.90B bookings in FY09; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.52x; +30% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.03; conservative 2yr +0%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY03-FY09, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +3.1%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 7.6-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +16.9%/yr (FY03-FY09 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +28.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY09); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2010-04-23) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.52x (26.1% downside to Bear $33 / +50.0% upside to Bull $67) | Adj composite 1.49 vs market 2.52: gap -1.03 [OVERVALUED] | +30% above the EPP floor $34 (13x FY10E $2.65) | Conservative 2-yr case: +0.4% total (+0.2%/yr) | At 16.9x FY10E the 15% hurdle price $59 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; consulting -9% LC in Q2, FY10 guided -3% to +1% LC; offshore competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
